assign.now: designing the format: drop full per-instance detail (sel/path/fix/detail) from every row, not just clean ones -- open() already re-measures a clean row live, extend that to all rows so no cap is ever needed again

log.msg: key finding while designing: problems() (the site-wide 'N kinds of problem' grouping) reads row.issues for EVERY row in the saved baseline, not just the opened one -- dropping issues from all rows would silently zero that whole section on a saved-baseline load. Fix: keep a per-row, per-instance, UNCAPPED compact summary (`rules`: {rule,title,sev}, no selector/path/fix/detail) that problems() reads instead; full detail is still only ever fetched live via frame() on open(). `rules.length` equals `counts.total` by construction -- there is no cap left to get wrong.
